lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately five distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit roughly equidistant horizontal spacing, with vertical intervals between blobs within a column appearing consistent across the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal carinae to form a lattice. High-luminance circular blobs are positioned at the intersections of these vertical bands and the horizontal spaces between ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary horizontal ridges are visible running across the upper third of the flank. Each ridge is characterized by a high-contrast gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadowing on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin shows a distribution of roughly 8-10 high-luminance blobs. The spatial arrangement is less structured than the flank, with higher density observed toward the anterior base of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A region of dense, high-frequency micro-spotting is present immediately posterior to the gill slits, which lacks the organized grid structure of the posterior lateral flank.
